page_title: SWE 5-1 TUN | Sweden v Tunisia 15/06/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' 5 - 1 Yasin Ayari (Sweden) receives a great pass from his teammate and strikes a very powerful shot towards goal that goes inside of the right post!
90+1' Graham Potter has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Daniel Svensson (Sweden) replacing Alexander Bernhardsson.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Alexander Isak goes off the pitch and Anthony Elanga (Sweden) comes on.
90' It will be a corner kick for Sweden.
90' Lucas Bergvall (Sweden) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Lucas Bergvall (Sweden) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
87' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Yael Perez to decide. The relieved Sweden players can finally celebrate.
85' Celebrations by Sweden are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.
84' 4 - 1 Goal! Mattias Svanberg (Sweden) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 4:1.
84' Substitution. Mattias Svanberg (Sweden) has come on for Jesper Karlstrom.
84' Sabri Lamouchi has decided to make a change. Firas Chaouat (Tunisia) replaces Anis Slimane.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ismael Gharbi (Tunisia) replaces Rani Khedira.
82' Sweden control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
80' Alexander Isak (Sweden) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
78' Elias Achouri (Tunisia) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
77' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Isak Hien (Sweden).
76' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Sweden.
76' Elliot Stroud (Sweden) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
76' The attendance is 50987.
75' 9:5 – the total goal attempt statistics.
72' The game has come to an end for Ellyes Skhiri. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Elias Achouri (Tunisia).
72' Sabri Lamouchi has decided to substitute Yan Valery and he is replaced by Mohamed Belhadj (Tunisia).
72' The manager makes a subsitution with Sebastian Tounekti (Tunisia) coming on for Elias Saad.
71' The match can continue after the interruption.
69' A cooling break is underway.
68' Lucas Bergvall (Sweden) attempts to find Viktor Gyökeres, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
68' Alexander Isak (Sweden) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked.
66' Viktor Gyökeres (Sweden) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar.
65' Graham Potter decides to make a substitution. Benjamin Nygren will be replaced by Lucas Bergvall (Sweden).
65' Problems for Graham Potter as Gabriel Gudmundsson (Sweden) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Elliot Stroud replaces him.
64' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Sweden) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
63' The resulting set piece from Tunisia is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
62' Yan Valery (Tunisia) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Tunisia are awarded a corner kick.

59' 3 - 1 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Viktor Gyökeres (Sweden) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 3:1.
58' Yan Valery (Tunisia) commits a rough foul. Yael Perez stops the game and makes a call.
56' Flag up against Alexander Isak (Sweden). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
55' Hannibal Mejbri (Tunisia) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
54' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Rani Khedira (Tunisia) was quite harsh and Yael Perez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
54' Alexander Isak (Sweden) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
52' Hannibal Mejbri (Tunisia) unleashed a promising strike from a long-distance free kick, but his effort goes high over the bar so it's going to be a goal kick.
52' Jesper Karlstrom (Sweden) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Yael Perez signals.
50' The linesman raises his flag. Alexander Isak (Sweden) is adjudged offside.
50' Hannibal Mejbri (Tunisia) sends a chip pass into the box, but Kristoffer Nordfeldt is quickest to intercept the ball.
49' Rani Khedira (Tunisia) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
48' Yan Valery (Tunisia) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Yael Perez blows his whistle for a foul.
47' Neat passing move from Tunisia in order to create new attacking opportunities.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+2' Yasin Ayari (Sweden) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Abdelmouhib Chamakh.
45+1' Ali Abdi (Tunisia) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
43' 2 - 1 Goal! Hannibal Mejbri swings the ball deep into the box and finds Omar Rekik (Tunisia) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the bottom left corner. 2:1.
41' 5:3 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
39' The Sweden players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
36' Abdelmouhib Chamakh leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Benjamin Nygren (Sweden).
36' Alexander Bernhardsson (Sweden) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Now Sweden have a corner.
34' Victor Lindelof (Sweden) leaps to meet the corner from Benjamin Nygren, but plants his header just over the bar from close range.
33' Benjamin Nygren (Sweden) will take a corner kick.

30' 2 - 0 Goal! Alexander Isak (Sweden) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a low drive from the edge of the box into the middle of the net, leaving Abdelmouhib Chamakh beaten. The score is 2:0.
27' Ali Abdi (Tunisia) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
25' The game gets underway again after that interruption.
23' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
21' Ali Abdi (Tunisia) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
18' Elias Saad (Tunisia) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
16' Alexander Isak (Sweden) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
15' 68:32 – the latest ball possession ratio.
13' Anis Slimane (Tunisia) is adjudged offside.
10' Dangerous play by Gustaf Lagerbielke (Sweden). Yael Perez blows his whistle for a foul.
7' 1 - 0 Goal! Yasin Ayari (Sweden) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot into the top right corner. It's 1:0.

7' Viktor Gyökeres (Sweden) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick low strike towards the middle of the goal that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a superb goal-line clearance.
5' Viktor Gyökeres (Sweden) evades challenges and shoots from the edge of the box. It's a good effort, but flies just over the bar.
3' Yan Valery (Tunisia) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Yael Perez blows his whistle for an infringement.
2' Victor Lindelof (Sweden) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
